decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the submitted plans AR-00, dated 09/04/07, received 11/10/12; AR-01, dated 09/04/07, received 11/10/12; AR-01-4, dated 21/04/09, received 23/01/13; Design & Access Statement, undated, received 11/10/2012 approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby approved is for a restaurant only and does not include approval for the production, sale or distribution of food for consumption off the premises.

Condition : 4 - Other than that approved as part of the subject application, no fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 9am to 11pm Monday to Saturday and 9am to 10pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 6 - Details of sound insulation between the ground floor and the first floor flat shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be implemented prior to the commencement of the restaurant and retained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - The fume extract system hereby approved shall be built in accordance with the approved plans, AR-01-4, dated 21/04/09, received 23/01/13. The fume extract system shall be secured to the building using anti-vibration fixings.

Condition : 8 - The access doorway to the restaurant hereby approved shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 9 - Means of vehicular access and service to the subject building shall be from the rear lane only and not from Great West Road.
description: Change of use of property from shop (use class A1) to restaurant (use class A3) and installation of fume extraction ducting.
